summary: Trinity Biotech plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting held September 30, 2026, the US-equivalent disclosure for a foreign private issuer. Shareholders approved all resolutions with at least 95% support, re-appointing Grant Thornton as statutory auditor until the next AGM, authorizing the board to set auditor remuneration, and re-appointing Dr Andrew Omidvar as director. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, or structural mechanic is disclosed. This is a routine AGM results notice; nothing for risk-arb watch.
